The Process

Getting Started With ZKC

01
Book a Call

Book a 15-minute phone call. It’s a simple intro to meet Zeke, talk through your business and goals, and discuss how we can work together.

02
Strategy Call

The next call goes hands-on. We open your ad account together to see what’s driving results and what might be draining your budget, then build a tailored plan to help you reach your goals.

03
Build

With the plan finalized, we build and set up everything included, ready for launch.

04
Launch

Your plan goes live on the agreed date, with performance monitored from day one.

05
Optimize & Scale

We track results and refine continuously, scaling what works and fixing what doesn’t.
